name: Combat Quasar Regression
description: Regression tests for quasar cannon mechanics (sector and atmosphere)

data.sql: WITH safe_sector AS (SELECT s.sector_id FROM sectors s WHERE s.sector_id > 100 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM planets p2 JOIN citadels c2 ON c2.planet_id = p2.planet_id WHERE p2.sector_id = s.sector_id AND c2.level >= 3 AND c2.qCannonSector > 0) ORDER BY s.sector_id DESC LIMIT 1), target AS (SELECT p.planet_id, safe_sector.sector_id FROM planets p JOIN citadels c ON p.planet_id = c.planet_id CROSS JOIN safe_sector WHERE c.level >= 3 AND c.qCannonSector > 0 AND c.qCannonAtmosphere > 0 ORDER BY p.planet_id LIMIT 1), moved AS (UPDATE planets p SET sector_id = t.sector_id FROM target t WHERE p.planet_id = t.planet_id RETURNING p.planet_id, t.sector_id) SELECT planet_id, sector_id FROM moved;
INSERT INTO sector_warps (from_sector, to_sector) VALUES (1, @{target_sector_id}), (@{target_sector_id}, 1) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

tests.name: Rig: Set survivable deterministic Quasar strengths

data.sql: UPDATE citadels SET qCannonSector = 1, qCannonAtmosphere = 1 WHERE planet_id = @{target_planet_id};

tests.name: Rig: Position victim_user player at Sector 1

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id = 1 WHERE name = 'victim_user';

tests.name: Rig: Position victim_user ship at Sector 1

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id = 1, hull = 100, shields = 100, fighters = 20, onplanet = FALSE, cloaked = NULL WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'victim_user');
